statement.essentials: Because the pattern differs from person to person, surgeons look for it early in the dissection rather than assuming it.
statement.anatomy: The authors of a systematic review conclude that early identification of the branching pattern during surgery reduces the risk of injuring the nerve; those of a meta-analysis advise utmost caution at parotidectomy because no classification captures the variation.

limitations: These are the authors’ conclusions from anatomical series; no study measured whether identifying the pattern early lowers injury rates.
